name: Keyboard Status
author: hell0world
description: Keyboard connection and lock-key status with a detail panel

barWidget.description: Keyboard glyph showing whether the keyboard is on the USB cable, a 2.4G dongle or Bluetooth, with a CAPS tag while Caps Lock is on and a panel listing every lock key.

schema.label: Device match
schema.description: Case-insensitive substring of the keyboard's input name, e.g. "galaxy100". Empty auto-detects USB/Bluetooth devices with a Caps Lock LED that are not mice. See `cat /proc/bus/input/devices`.

schema.label: Show CAPS tag in the bar
schema.description: Adds a CAPS tag beside the glyph while Caps Lock is on.

schema.label: Hide when the keyboard is gone
schema.description: Off keeps a dimmed glyph when no matching keyboard is connected.
